goal: Choose the primary architecture pattern for a new order-processing service expected to scale from 10k to 1M events/day within 18 months

constraints.description: Must be operable by a 4-person backend team without hiring specialists
Must fit within the approved infra budget for year one

options.label: Modular Monolith
options.description: Single deployable, internally modularized by domain boundary

options.label: Microservices
options.description: Independently deployable services per bounded context, async messaging between them

options.label: Event-Driven (Event Sourcing + CQRS)
options.description: Append-only event log as source of truth, read models projected separately

criteria.label: Performance
criteria.description: Expected request/event latency and throughput headroom under target load. Adapt: replace with your own p95-latency or throughput target.

criteria.label: Scalability
criteria.description: Ability to scale individual hot paths independently as load grows 100x. Adapt: weight this higher if growth projections are aggressive or uncertain.

criteria.label: Team Fit
criteria.description: How well the pattern matches current team size, skill set, and on-call maturity. Adapt: score honestly against the team you have, not the team you wish you had.

criteria.label: Operational Cost
criteria.description: Lower is better. Infra spend plus on-call/operational burden at target scale. Adapt: substitute your own dollar or person-hour estimate per option.

criteria.label: Ecosystem Maturity
criteria.description: Availability of mature libraries, hosting options, observability tooling, and hiring pool for this pattern.

criteria.label: Security
criteria.description: Ease of enforcing auth boundaries, least-privilege access, and auditability across the architecture.
